en: Black‑and‑white view of a European spa or resort town street lined with ornate late‑19th‑century apartment and hotel facades. In the foreground is a curved riverside promenade with trees, pavilions and kiosks, horse‑drawn carriages and pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing. At the bottom right is part of a decorative cast‑iron colonnade or pavilion roof. The architecture is richly detailed, with bay windows, balconies and mansard roofs.
